name: Lessons With An Older Woman
source: One Spring evening, college student Newton arrives at older student June's home to help her with an assignment.  From the moment the door opens, something seems... off.  Help Newton decide how to proceed.
translation: 春天的一个晚上，大学生牛顿来到高年级学生琼的家，帮助她完成一项作业。从门打开的那一刻起，似乎有什么东西……不对劲。帮助牛顿决定如何继续。
